info.name: CYCLES_FRAME_CHANNELS
info.comment: Cycles vendor extension: additional frame channels backed by Cycles render passes, created lazily when the corresponding 'channel.*' frame parameter is set (unused channels cost nothing). Each channel supports exactly one data type, matching the backing pass. The renderer 'mistStart'/'mistDepth'/'mistFalloff' parameters drive the 'channel.mist' distance mapping (Cycles Film sockets).

parameters.name: channel.position
parameters.description: enables mapping the world-space position channel (Cycles 'position' pass; first-hit surface position)

parameters.name: channel.roughness
parameters.description: enables mapping the roughness channel (Cycles 'roughness' pass; first-hit BSDF roughness)

parameters.name: channel.mist
parameters.description: enables mapping the mist/depth-fog channel in [0,1] (Cycles 'mist' pass; distance mapping set by the renderer 'mistStart'/'mistDepth'/'mistFalloff' parameters)

parameters.name: channel.motion
parameters.description: enables mapping the 2D screen-space motion-vector channel as (prev.xy, next.xy) pixel offsets (Cycles 'motion' pass); Cycles only computes motion vectors when motion blur is inactive (degenerate camera shutter), zero otherwise

parameters.name: channel.sampleCount
parameters.description: enables mapping the per-pixel accumulated sample count channel (Cycles 'sample_count' pass); with 'adaptiveSampling' on the renderer this shows where sampling stopped early

parameters.name: channel.shadowCatcher
parameters.description: enables mapping the shadow-catcher channel (Cycles 'shadow_catcher' pass): the shadowed/unshadowed lighting ratio on CYCLES_SURFACE_COMPOSITING 'shadowCatcher' surfaces, for multiplying caught shadows onto a backplate; 1 (unshadowed) without catcher objects

parameters.name: channel.shadowCatcherMatte
parameters.description: enables mapping the shadow-catcher matte channel (Cycles 'shadow_catcher_matte' pass): the non-catcher objects' contribution with the approximate caught shadow composited in, for alpha-over onto a backplate; reads zero (with a warning) when the world has no CYCLES_SURFACE_COMPOSITING 'shadowCatcher' surfaces

parameters.name: mistStart
parameters.description: distance from the camera at which 'channel.mist' starts (Cycles Film 'mist_start')

parameters.name: mistDepth
parameters.description: distance over which 'channel.mist' ramps from 0 to 1 past 'mistStart' (Cycles Film 'mist_depth')

parameters.name: mistFalloff
parameters.description: exponent of the 'channel.mist' ramp: 1 linear, 2 quadratic, 0.5 square root (Cycles Film 'mist_falloff')
